tools.name: appboard_alternatives_to
tools.description: Find products offered as alternatives to a tool the user ALREADY USES — "what can I use instead of Notion / Product Hunt / Zapier". Pass the tool's target slug. This differs from appboard_find_alternatives, which starts from a product listed on AppBoard; use this one when the user names the tool they want to replace. Call appboard_list_alternative_targets when unsure which slug a tool has.

tool.description: the tool the user wants to replace, as an AppBoard target slug from appboard_list_alternative_targets, e.g. 'product-hunt' or 'notion'

tools.name: appboard_browse_taxonomy
tools.description: List the controlled vocabulary for a dimension — categories, use cases, platforms, audiences or pricing models. Call this to discover the exact filter values appboard_find_products accepts, and to answer "what categories exist". Each term carries the appboardUrl of its browse page.

kind.description: which vocabulary to list: category, use_case, platform, audience or pricing

tools.name: appboard_find_alternatives
tools.description: Find alternatives and competitors to a specific product. Use this for "what's a good alternative to X" or "what else is like X". Alternatives that are themselves on AppBoard include a slug you can pass to appboard_product_details and an appboardUrl. When the tool being replaced has an AppBoard collection, alternativesPage is the URL of that "alternatives to X" page — share it with the user.

slug.description: the product's AppBoard slug, as returned by appboard_find_products

tools.name: appboard_find_products
tools.description: Search AppBoard for software products by need, category, use case, platform, audience or pricing model. Use this whenever the user asks what tool to use for a job ("a free email API", "note-taking apps for teams"). Results are ranked by real community engagement, not by advertising. Filter values are the names returned by appboard_browse_taxonomy — an unknown name is an error, so list the vocabulary first if you are unsure. Each product carries an appboardUrl, and each of its categories, use cases and platforms carries the appboardUrl of its browse page.

query.description: free-text terms to match against product names and taglines

category.description: comma-separated category names from appboard_browse_taxonomy, e.g. 'ai,developer-tools'

limit.description: how many products to return (1-50, default 10)

tools.name: appboard_list_alternative_targets
tools.description: List the tools AppBoard has alternatives for, most-covered first, with the slug to pass to appboard_alternatives_to. Use it to resolve a tool name to a slug, or to answer "what tools do you cover alternatives for".

limit.description: how many targets to return (1-50, default 10)

tools.name: appboard_product_details
tools.description: Get everything AppBoard knows about one product: what it does, its pricing model, platforms, use cases, target audiences, community metrics, any discount code, and its alternatives. Use after appboard_find_products when the user asks about a specific product. Taxonomy terms link to their browse pages; an alternative that has its own AppBoard collection carries alternativesPage — the URL to open for it.

slug.description: the product's AppBoard slug, as returned by appboard_find_products

tools.name: appboard_trending
tools.description: List the products gaining the most community momentum in a time window. Use this for "what's new/hot/trending" questions. Ranked by AppBoard's Points-Based Score, which weights recent upvotes, comments, follows and saves by recency.

period.description: time window: today, yesterday, week, month or all (default week)

limit.description: how many products to return (1-50, default 10)
